calls.title: Experimentation Squad Weekly Meeting
calls.summary: The team scheduled multiple kickoff meetings to focus on cleaning up legacy experiment flows, improving metrics, and simplifying experiment approval processes to support large-scale customers. Michael is leading efforts to eliminate duplicated flows while Luke Sonnet is defining power calculation requirements. An engineering-focused session aims to brainstorm ways to streamline approvals. Stakeholder feedback is driving project priorities, emphasizing the need for simpler approval flows. Collaboration between design and engineering is crucial, with Gabe Melean leading cleanup efforts. Additionally, code reviews are progressing, with team members managing a backlog. A complex new metric creation for funnel metrics is being integrated, necessitating UI adjustments. The team is also focused on legacy system cleanup and maintaining open communication regarding workloads and absences.
calls.keywords: Experiment approval, power calculation, Funnel Metrics, legacy cleanup, visual nits, contextual bandits
